theory.title: Придаточные уступки

head: Связка
После неё
Пример
rows: although / even though / though
предложение
Although it was raining, we went out.
despite / in spite of
существительное или -ing
Despite the rain, we went out. / In spite of feeling ill, she worked.
however / nevertheless
новое предложение
It was expensive. However, it was worth it.

theory.tip: despite of — ошибка. Правильно: despite или in spite of. С предложением: despite the fact that…

theory.title: Придаточные цели

head: Связка
Пример
rows: to / in order to / so as to + V
I left early (in order) to catch the train.
so that + can / could / would
I spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
for + существительное / -ing
This knife is for cutting bread.

theory.tip: Отрицание цели: so as not to / in order not to: I set two alarms so as not to oversleep.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite using the word in brackets.

items.prompt: Although she was tired, she finished the report. (despite)
answers: Despite being tired, she finished the report.
Despite feeling tired, she finished the report.
Despite her tiredness, she finished the report.

items.prompt: He saved money because he wanted to buy a car. (in order to)
answers: He saved money in order to buy a car.

items.prompt: The film was long. It was very good. (however)
answers: The film was long. However, it was very good.

exercises.title: The ad that went wrong
exercises.text: In 2017 a big drinks company launched an advert in order to show that its product could bring people together. However, despite a huge budget and a famous model, the commercial was attacked online within hours. Critics said it made light of serious protests in order to sell soft drinks. Although the company apologised the next day and removed the ad, it became one of the most famous marketing mistakes ever — proof that going viral isn't always good news.

script.speaker: Founder
script.text: Our app helps people share leftover food so that nothing is wasted. Although we only launched six months ago, we already have fifty thousand users. We're here today in order to find investors. Despite strong competitors, we believe our community approach makes us different.

theory.title: Неисчисляемые и «множественные» существительные

head: Группа
Примеры
Как говорить
rows: всегда неисчисляемые (в русском — исчисляемые!)
advice, information, news, furniture, luggage, equipment, research, progress, accommodation
a piece of advice, some news (The news is good.)
только мн. число
jeans, trousers, scissors, glasses, clothes, goods, belongings
a pair of jeans, My glasses are…
меняют смысл
a paper (газета) / paper (бумага); a glass / glass; an experience / experience (опыт)

theory.tip: Не говорят an advice, informations, a news. The police — всегда множественное число: The police are coming.

theory.title: Приставки и суффиксы
theory.text: un-/in-/im-/dis-/ir- (не-): unreliable, impatient, dishonest, irresponsible. over-/under-: overpaid, underestimate. -ful/-less: careful/careless. -able: affordable. re-: rewrite, rebuild.

exercises.title: Travel light
exercises.text: Airlines lose about 25 million pieces of luggage every year. That's why more travellers are choosing to take only hand luggage. Experts' advice is simple: pack clothes that can be combined, roll them instead of folding, and remember that most hotels provide basic equipment like hairdryers. 'The best piece of advice I ever got,' says one frequent flyer, 'was to lay out everything I wanted to take — and then put half of it back.'
